messages:
maria: heads-up — penetration test kickoff next Tue. need a short pre-pt checklist for staging: RBAC changes, KMS access window, audit log exports, and remediation tracking. who can own which pieces?

alex: I can take RBAC changes. plan: create ephemeral roles via sts:AssumeRole with time-limited session, document ARNs, and add an allowlist for assessor IPs.

sam: for audit logs we should export CloudTrail + ALB logs to a sealed S3 bucket with versioning + MFA delete. retention >= 90d per assessor ask. Also need signed manifest for evidence.

jordan: +1. For KMS, prefer a key policy grant for the assessor principal instead of broad IAM perms. if team wants ephemeral grants we can use a temporary KMS grant id and revoke after window.

lee: can someone paste the example CLI for creating a KMS grant and the presigned evidence upload? makes reviews easier.

alex: sure — example KMS grant: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-evidence-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-role --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey --name pt-grant-$(date +%s)
```
presign upload for S3 (tmp creds):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/staging/2024-11-12.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```

sam: evidence naming convention: project-<assessor>-<date>-<sha>.tar.gz and put a checksum file alongside. also include a README.json with the CloudTrail timeframe and key-fingerprint.

maria: retention question: legal asked for 1y for high-criticality items. assessor only needs 90d, but legal > can we meet both?

jordan: yes — use lifecycle rules: transition to cold storage after 90d, keep index/metadata searchable. export snapshots of CloudTrail to the compliance bucket monthly.

lee: about remediation tracking — propose a GH project board called pt-remediate-<engagement-id>. Issues tagged: pt-blocker, pt-minor, pt-observed. PRs must reference issue number. we can automate status updates via a webhook to this channel.

maria: owners: alex -> RBAC change PR, sam -> audit export config and S3 bucket + lifecycle, jordan -> KMS grants + key-policy, lee -> GH project + webhook. I will coordinate with the assessor ops contact to confirm windows.

sec-bot: evidence-bot created S3 bucket redwood-pt-evidence-staging-170550 for this engagement and posted bucket policy (sealed).

alex: quick QA: does anyone object to granting assessor AssumeRole to a role in our account vs cross-account role? cross-account is cleaner.

sam: cross-account preferred. less blast-radius. just ensure CloudTrail is logging cross-account events (it will).

lee: retest plan: canary retest (subset of issues) scheduled first day, full retest after fixes applied. acceptance criteria: no pt-blocker open + tests from eval-suite pass (smoke auth, telemetry, key-access).

jordan: add an observability proof: run a scripted trace that shows end-to-end request with KV cache key so assessor can see logs. put the script under /ops/pt-scripts/trace.sh and generate the trace ID in evidence.

maria: timeline ask: RBAC & KMS grants must be ready by Mon EOD so assessor can run dryrun Tue morning. can everyone confirm?

alex: confirm, I'll post PR today.

sam: confirm, creating bucket + lifecycle now. will post config URL.

jordan: confirm, key policy draft incoming.

lee: I'll create GH project and webhook; will post board link here.

maria: awesome, thanks. tagging ops contact @assessor-ops and putting retest window tentative Tue 11:00-14:00 PST. please add any blockers here. :thumbsup:

alex: no blockers from infra. :+1:

sam: minor: need approval from compliance for 1y retention. pinging @legal for signoff.

jordan: noted — if legal holds up we can still do 90d for assessor artifacts and snapshot key metadata to the compliance bucket.

maria: perfect. i'll follow up with compliance + assessor-ops. will log this thread into the engagement doc.

lee: posting board link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pt-remediate/projects/8 (assignee map and labels done)

sec-bot: automation: webhook configured to post issue status updates to this channel.

maria: closing action items: alex (RBAC PR), sam (bucket + lifecycle + manifest), jordan (KMS policy + grant script), lee (GH project + webhook). folks, please update the GH issues as you complete tasks so the remediation tracker reflects retest readiness.

alex: will do.

sam: will do.

jordan: will do.

maria: thanks team — expect a dryrun status check Monday 17:00 PST.
